title: Crownfall update after your feedback: new class builds, less clutter, and a Berserker
author: pixels_that
selftext:
Hey again! I posted Crownfall here recently, and the feedback about UI clutter, progression, and abilities feeling disconnected from matching was really helpful. Thanks to everyone who played and left detailed notes.

I’ve reworked the characters around the same swap controls, but with class-specific decks and rewards. There are 40 new pieces across the five playstyles. Mage can charge Runes through red matches before triggering them, while Rogue can prepare marks to make knife attacks more dependable. Berserker also has a separate selection and its own animated axe-wielding sprite alongside Sentinel. 

I’ve cut down some of the text, cleaned up the icons, and worked on the matching effects and transitions. I’m still using AI assistance for implementation and testing, with PixelLab for the pixel art. Getting the art consistent took several attempts, keeping the generated frames in order and checking them against the actual backgrounds helped. I know I still need more polish but it's definitely getting there. 

The updated build is free to play: [Play Crownfall](https://xedd.itch.io/crownfall).

I’m especially interested in whether the new pieces give you a build to work toward, or whether the run still feels aimless. Do matching and abilities feel more connected now? Please mention your character, device and browser if you try it.
